query: WITH filtered AS (SELECT name, last_updated, manifest_digest FROM container_registry_repository_tag WHERE repository_id = $1 AND ($2::TEXT IS NULL OR name ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%') AND ($3::TEXT IS NULL OR manifest_digest ILIKE '%' || $3 || '%') AND ($4::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL OR last_updated >= $4) AND ($5::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL OR last_updated <= $5)) SELECT page.name AS "name?", page.last_updated AS "last_updated?", page.manifest_digest AS "manifest_digest?", total.count AS "count!" FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM filtered) AS total LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM filtered ORDER BY last_updated DESC LIMIT $6 OFFSET $7) AS page ON TRUE;
